name: Creamy Smothered Onion Pork Chops (Keto Skillet)
ingredients_verbatim: 4 pork chops (about 2 pounds total, bone-in, thick center-cut pork loin chops)
why: Bang-on the target band from the source card: 483 cal, 47g protein, 4g total carbs per serving. Structurally low-carb (seared pork chops smothered in a butter-onion-cream-broth pan sauce, no rice/potato/pasta). Every ingredient maps to the board (pork-chops, onions, butter, heavy-cream, chicken-broth, olive-oil). Weigh-and-divide skillet that scales cleanly to 14. Distinct from the run's already-accepted creamy-garlic-herb-wine-pork-chops (no wine, no herbs; this is a plain onion-cream smother).
